user.title: Sign in to Philips Home Access
user.description: Use an account dedicated to Home Assistant: the Philips cloud keeps one session per account, so signing in here signs out a phone that uses the same account. Add a family member in the Philips app and use that account.

data_description.email: The email address of the account.
data_description.areacode: The phone country code of the account, without the plus sign, for example 84.

pick.title: Choose the lock
pick.description: The account has several locks. Each lock is one configuration entry.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Philips cloud refused the credentials of {email}. Enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Philips cloud.
error.invalid_auth: The Philips cloud refused the email or the password.
error.no_locks: The account has no lock that this integration can use.

lock_not_supported.message: {name} locks itself about 5 seconds after unlocking; there is no lock command.
